title: Chest, Rib & Back Aids
description: Lumbar belts, rib braces, chest binders, and dorso lumbar supports for back pain, rib injuries, and post-operative spinal care.

products.name: Ash Brace
features: Rigid anterior chest panel with adjustable posterior straps
Foam-padded contact surfaces for patient comfort
Universal fit accommodates a wide chest circumference range
Lightweight construction for minimal patient burden
benefits: Stabilises the thoracic cage after rib fractures and sternum injuries
Reduces movement of fractured rib segments to control pain during breathing
Supports the chest wall post-thoracic surgery
Helps patients breathe more confidently by limiting painful chest excursion

products.name: Rib Belt
products.sizes: S, M, L, XL, XXL, Universal, Child
features: Wide elastic band with targeted compression over the injured rib zone
Hook-and-loop closure for adjustable compression level
Breathable elastic fabric reduces heat and discomfort
Available in adult, universal, and paediatric sizes
benefits: Compresses the rib cage to limit painful expansion during breathing and coughing
Supports fractured or bruised ribs during conservative management
Reduces pain with movement, allowing patients to breathe more freely
Compact and discreet — can be worn under clothing

products.name: Chest Binder
features: Full-length elastic panel covers the entire thoracic region
Firm compression fabric supports healing chest wall tissues
Wide velcro closure for easy adjustment over varying body contours
Smooth inner surface minimises skin friction
benefits: Provides firm chest wall compression after surgeries such as open-heart procedures
Reduces post-operative swelling and wound site movement
Supports breast tissue after mastectomy or chest reconstruction
Offers psychological comfort and confidence during early post-surgical recovery

products.name: Contoured L S Belt
products.sizes: S, M, L, XL, XXL, XXXL
features: Anatomically contoured lumbar panel with built-in rigid stays
Wide abdominal apron distributes support load across the lower back
Elastic side panels for a secure fit during movement
Removable stays allow customisable rigidity levels
benefits: Supports the lumbosacral junction to relieve chronic low back pain
Reduces intervertebral disc pressure during daily activities
Helps manage lumbar muscle strain, spondylosis, and disc prolapse symptoms
Encourages correct lumbar posture to prevent pain recurrence

products.name: Lumbar Sacral Belt
products.sizes: S, M, L, XL, XXL, XXXL
features: Extended coverage from the lower thoracic to the sacrum
Multiple rigid posterior stays for comprehensive spinal support
Breathable elastic fabric with moisture-wicking properties
Double-pull tensioning system for precise compression adjustment
benefits: Stabilises the lumbar and sacral spine after vertebral fractures and fusions
Reduces painful spinal movement during rehabilitation and daily tasks
Supports the lower back in occupational settings with prolonged standing or lifting
Helps manage sacroiliac joint dysfunction and lumbar instability

products.name: Dorso Lumbar Brace
features: Thoraco-lumbar coverage with anterior sternal pad and posterior rigid frame
Adjustable shoulder straps retract the shoulders into correct alignment
Modular design allows fitting for different torso lengths
Padded contact surfaces at all bony prominences
benefits: Immobilises the thoracic and lumbar spine post-vertebral fracture or surgery
Corrects thoracic kyphosis by extending the spine and retracting the shoulders
Reduces pain during weight-bearing after vertebral compression fractures
Prescribed for osteoporotic fractures and post-spinal fusion support
